title: Life Need Compassion
author: Nurul Hoque
text:
Our life is not many times like a toy
That we played in our adolescence
For one who is singing for a joy
Not know the meaning of essence

Life couldn`t be sometimes splendid
We are swimming in a salty tear
For a breath of ebullience and placid
We are need to count many a year

Life is not for undue undesirable fun
We should know the meaning of it
Need to know what is compassion
That can build by glacial concrete

Let all of us come to crave the dream
Life needs compassion as sun beam.
